name: edstem-cli
description: Agent-first CLI and MCP server for Ed Discussion

scripts.build: npm run build:local && npm run build:remote && npm run worker:build
scripts.build:remote: rm -rf dist/remote && bun build src/remote/index.ts src/remote/admin.ts --outdir dist/remote --target bun && cp -R src/remote/db/migrations dist/remote/migrations
scripts.pack:check: npm pack --dry-run --json | node -e "let data=''; process.stdin.on('data', c => data += c); process.stdin.on('end', () => { const files = JSON.parse(data)[0]?.files?.map(f => f.path) ?? []; for (const required of ['dist/edstem.js','dist/edstem-mcp.js','dist/remote/index.js']) if (!files.includes(required)) throw new Error('npm package is missing ' + required); });"
scripts.pack:smoke: tmp="$(mktemp -d)" && npm pack --pack-destination "$tmp" >/dev/null && npm install --prefix "$tmp/install" "$tmp"/edstem-cli-*.tgz >/dev/null && test "$("$tmp/install/node_modules/.bin/edstem" --version)" = "$(node -p "JSON.parse(require('node:fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8')).version")" && test -x "$tmp/install/node_modules/.bin/edstem-mcp"
scripts.test: npm run test:node && npm run test:worker && npm run test:remote
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
